sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [LOGIC] gs:IMO116Shape/sh:or: The conditional trigger is implemented only through nltl:notComminutedOrDisinfected, while nltl:sewageDischargeType is merely required to exist and is never constrained to the not-comminuted-or-disinfected value. Consequently, arbitrary sewage discharge types can enter either branch, and a discharge type requiring the condition can pass through the false branch if the separate boolean is false. Required change: Constrain nltl:sewageDischargeType to the not-comminuted-or-disinfected value as the applicability condition, or explicitly enforce consistency between that value and nltl:notComminutedOrDisinfected before applying the conditional requirements.

[INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] MainShape/sh:or first branch/nltl:nearbyIceConcentration and nltl:iceConcentration: The applicable branch makes both concentration quantities mandatory and requires each to be greater than 0.1. The requirement requires recording the distance from areas whose ice concentration exceeds 1/10, but does not require two separate concentration observations on the ship or impose these independent mandatory checks. Required change: Remove the mandatory greater-than-0.1 constraints on nearbyIceConcentration and iceConcentration, retaining the required distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth record and the applicable distance and compliance constraints.

[LOGIC] gs:IMO116Shape sh:property nltl:notComminutedOrDisinfected and the sh:or branches: The requirement makes sewageDischargeType the sole applicability condition, but the candidate additionally requires notComminutedOrDisinfected and gates the conditional obligations on its boolean value. A conforming record with sewageDischargeType equal to not_comminuted_or_disinfected and all required MARPOL and distance conditions can therefore fail merely because this redundant property is absent or false; non-target discharge types are also unnecessarily constrained to have this property false. Required change: Remove the mandatory and branch-gating constraints on nltl:notComminutedOrDisinfected, or otherwise make all MARPOL and distance obligations depend solely on sewageDischargeType = "not_comminuted_or_disinfected".
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
